chapter: Back to Los Angeles and joining Basie
title: His wife goes to New York and he writes arrangements for Willie Bryant by mail
summary: Derby got a job at the Ubangi Club in New York and arranged for Clayton to write for Willie Bryant's band by mail.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: But we went in there, we played there and we played all around Los Angeles and the San Francisco vicinity. We played in a nightclub called "The Club Araby", and the band was, sounded good. But my wife got an offer to come to New York to work in a club here called the "Ubangi" Club and Willie Bryant was the leader of the band in the Ubangi.
And my wife and about six

other girls all went to New York, all came to New York. So when she got here she wrote and told me how different Harlem was from California. It was an entirely different life, like black and white, you know.

Although I liked New York in a different way than I liked California, I always wanted to come. So after my wife came she arranged for me to make arrangements for Willie Bryant's band through the mail.

Willie would write me and tell me what he's got. How many trombones he's got. How many trumpets and what is high, certain guys can play. And Matthews, big Matthews was one of the guys. Willie always said, I've got a man that can play real high on trombone if you want to make certain notes. So I was making.......
